description.p: Reviera is a parametric Building Information Modeling (BIM) application for architecture, structure and MEP. IFC is its native file format, so there is no proprietary container. Every operation can be driven by Lua scripts and by AI agents through the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
This is an early pre-release. It already models a small building end to end:

ul.li: Straight and curved walls, doors and windows, floors, ceilings and decks
Hip, gable, arched and domed roofs with eaves and dormers
Stairs, railings with gates, rooms, levels and grids
Overlap detection with kept booleans, and door clearance checks
Plans, ceiling plans, sections, elevations, schedules and sheets to PDF and COBie

description.p: Help lists sample models to open, and the Castle Turret plugin shows what a Lua plugin can do.

description.p: Second pre-release (tag 0.1.0-pre.2), for testing: structure, steel and concrete detailing, MEP systems, analysis, coordination (BCF issues), annotation in sections, elevations and 3D, and a sample with a walkthrough for every ribbon tab.
